creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`FileProjectStore.EnsureInitialized` saves `.kan/config.toml` whenever its schema differs from the running kan's, including when the file is newer, and `Save` drops fields kan doesn't know. Phase 4 adds `project/3` with `[linked_boards]`, which an older kan would silently strip. Project config is also missing from `MigrateService.MigrationPlan`.

Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Read commands never write inside a project", the paragraph on project config. This has to ship before any project schema bump. Fixtures should cover a missing project config and one newer than the running kan.
title: Protect project config from being rewritten by an older kan
